title: CodeGama Operations Executive job for freshers

scenes.say: Freshers, job alert! CodeGama in Bengaluru is hiring Operations Executives in bulk.

items: Salary: up to ₹2 LPA, based on skills
scenes.say: The role is Operations Executive at CodeGama Private Limited. You must relocate to Bengaluru and work rotational shifts. Salary is up to two lakh rupees a year, based on your skills.
Who can apply? Freshers who have completed a degree in any stream, with good communication skills and basic M S Excel. This opening is for male candidates only.

items: Never pay money to anyone for a job
scenes.say: To apply, email your resume to marketing at codegama dot com, and mention the referral I D, CODEGAMA O P S 26. Never pay money to anyone for a job.
Full details are in the description. More free job updates on Marg Disha dot com.
